Must-fixes applied: "pregnancy test", "bedside" and "prepare the blood" in step1 lines were the best options' wording, now ask which first tests she needs and why her pressure is low; "fresh blood loss" (step3 lap [2]) and "support" (step4 [2]) were the step 4 and step 5 best options' words; a later pass found "show most quickly" and "at once" echoed the scan options' lines, now "In shock like this, which first tests would you send now?" and "which first tests does she need while fluids are running?".
